description: Utility class for CoAP Efento measurements, including conversion methods, measurement setting, and sensor type checks.

classes.name: CoapEfentoUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing measurement conversion, default measurement setup, and sensor type identification functions.

methods.name: convertByteArrayToString
methods.description: Converts a byte array to a hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: convertTimestampToUtcString
methods.description: Converts a timestamp in milliseconds to a UTC formatted date string.

methods.name: setDefaultMeasurements
methods.description: Creates a JsonObject with default measurement properties including serial number, battery status, timestamps, signal, and measurement interval.

methods.name: isBinarySensor
methods.description: Determines if a measurement type corresponds to a binary sensor.

methods.name: isSensorError
methods.description: Checks if a sample offset indicates a sensor error based on predefined range.
